en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

That's not something you should 
invite a girl to go read.

You didn't just say that on purpose to 
get yelled at or something, did you?
I was thinking the same thing!

Novels and literature are fine, but 
first you gotta check out the manga.

Manga are so great!
The pinnacle of human culture!

Really? I get all psyched up when 
I'm surrounded by books...
I guess we won't really get along...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tsumugi looks deep in thought...
